sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A European perennial spurge, usually 15–60 cm tall. It grows in herb-rich deciduous woodland, clearings and woodland margins.

sections.title: Leaves and fruit
sections.text: The alternate leaves are about 2–6 cm long, green above and glaucous beneath. The cyathia have greenish glands that may turn red; the capsule is warty.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: The latex is irritating and toxic according to the floras consulted. Do not ingest the plant or allow its sap to contact eyes or skin.
